mcp.name: onboarder_triage
mcp.title: Triage
mcp.description: Read-only GitHub PR queue or exact-head inspection for this repository’s GitHub origin. Reuses CLI/web review, priority and evidence. No AI calls, tests, fetches, assignments or GitHub writes. Metadata-only priorities are provisional; missing checks stay unknown. Source patches require explicit includeSource.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

mcp.name: onboarder_intelligence
mcp.title: Intelligence
mcp.description: Refresh repository intelligence: architecture boundaries, measured coverage, packages, routes, journeys, knowledge freshness and optional semantic symbols. Retrieve revision-pinned evidence or compare exact Git revisions. Source excerpts require includeSource; otherwise read cited files with onboarder_read_file.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

mcp.name: onboarder_scan
mcp.title: Scan
mcp.description: Scan a repository and return everything Onboarder knows about it: structure, entry points, hubs, cycles, dependencies, services, health, security, history and a written overview. Start here. The returned `root` is what every other tool takes as its `path`.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

force.description: Rescan even if this repository is already cached. Defaults to false.

mcp.name: onboarder_rescan
mcp.title: Rescan
mcp.description: Discard the cached analysis for a repository and scan it again. Use after changing files on disk, since every other tool answers from the cached scan.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

mcp.name: onboarder_overview
mcp.title: Overview
mcp.description: The repository in one call: written summary, languages, entry points, the files everything depends on, dependency cycles, services, and what the scan is unsure about. Cheap, because it reads the cached analysis rather than scanning again.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

mcp.name: onboarder_architecture
mcp.title: Architecture
mcp.description: How the code is arranged: the dependency layers and which files sit in each, files nothing reaches, the architectural patterns detected (hub-and-spoke, cycles, god objects, layer violations), which folders import each other, and the services detected.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

mcp.name: onboarder_tour
mcp.title: Tour
mcp.description: A guided reading order for a new contributor: the handful of files worth reading first, each with the reason it matters and how many files depend on it. The fastest way to understand an unfamiliar repository.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

mcp.name: onboarder_health
mcp.title: Health
mcp.description: Maintainability report: an overall score and letter grade, what the score is made of, and the riskiest files with their size, complexity, dependency counts and blast radius.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 20, capped at 200.

mcp.name: onboarder_security
mcp.title: Security
mcp.description: Static security findings from the built-in rules: hardcoded secrets, unsafe calls, injection patterns and the rest, ordered by severity. These are the built-in rules only — use onboarder_deep_analysis for the external scanners.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 20, capped at 200.

mcp.name: onboarder_history
mcp.title: History
mcp.description: What git knows: commit count, contributors, and the files with the highest churn weighted against complexity — the change-risk hotspots, plus files only one person has ever touched and files that keep changing together without importing each other.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 20, capped at 200.

mcp.name: onboarder_dependencies
mcp.title: Dependencies
mcp.description: The dependency inventory: languages, package managers, every declared dependency with version, category and documentation link, the project license with its compliance counts, and the CI workflows with their triggers and jobs.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

mcp.name: onboarder_explain_file
mcp.title: Explain File
mcp.description: Explain one file: its role in the codebase, what it imports, what imports it, its exports, its metrics, and a written summary. Set includeSource to get the file text as well.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

includeSource.description: Also return the full file text. Defaults to false.

mcp.name: onboarder_explain_folder
mcp.title: Explain Folder
mcp.description: Explain one folder: what lives in it, which folders it imports, its entry points and hubs, and a written summary of what the folder is for. Pass an empty string for the repository root.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

folder.description: Repository-relative folder, for example server/mcp. Use "" for the root.

mcp.name: onboarder_read_file
mcp.title: Read File
mcp.description: The text of one file inside the repository. Paths outside the repository are refused, and files over 200 KB are refused rather than truncated. Optional startLine/endLine return up to 500 lines with line numbers and totalLines — use onboarder_search to locate the part you need. Symlinks and binary files are refused.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

endLine.description: Last line to read, inclusive. At most 500 lines per range.

mcp.name: onboarder_list_files
mcp.title: List Files
mcp.description: List the files in the repository, or in one folder. Filter by a substring of the path, by extension, and by whether the file is a test.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

folder.description: Repository-relative folder. Use "" for the whole repository.

contains.description: Keep only paths containing this text.

extension.description: Keep only this extension, with or without the dot, e.g. "js".

tests.description: true keeps only test files, false excludes them.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 20, capped at 200.

mcp.name: onboarder_search
mcp.title: Search
mcp.description: Search the repository the way the app's search palette does: bare words rank by relevance, and the full query language works too — path:, ext:, is:test, is:source, "exact phrases", -exclude, /regex/, and case: for case sensitivity.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 20, capped at 200.

caseSensitive.description: Match case exactly. Defaults to false.

mcp.name: onboarder_deep_analysis
mcp.title: Deep Analysis
mcp.description: Run the optional external analyzers (semgrep, gitleaks, knip, and the rest) over the repository and return their findings normalized. Slower than the built-in tools, and it only covers the analyzers that are actually installed. Call onboarder_analyzer_status first to see which those are.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository on this machine (for example /Users/you/code/my-app). The path returned by onboarder_scan is the one to reuse. Omit it to use the last repository scanned.

tools.description: Which analyzers to run. Omit to run every installed one.

mcp.name: onboarder_analyzer_status
mcp.title: Analyzer Status
mcp.description: Which external analyzers are installed on this machine, what each one is for, and how to install the ones that are missing. Takes no arguments.
